keyFindings.description: flushWindowElapsedError (confirm.go:60-67) is the merge's only new code, and no test pins it. A mutant whose Error() returns other text and whose Unwrap() returns nil passes ./internal/bus and ./internal/dispatch/outbox. Both properties matter: the text is the one log filters match, and the unwrap makes window.answered report a spent flush as ErrUnavailable, so the outbox releases the event instead of failing it (outbox/publisher.go). implement.json says main's window tests cover it; the surviving mutant shows they do not. Add a test: confirmFlushed with a past deadline gives errWindowElapsed's text and errors.Is errFlushWindowElapsed, and window.answered on a current window gives ErrUnavailable for it.

Two 5 s constants with contradicting comments. publishAcknowledgementTimeout's comment (async.go:16-17, main's) says it bounds one publish, its connection wait and its JetStream acknowledgement or core flush. After the merge, Publish, PublishCoreTo, publishJetStream and publishCoreTo use publishBound instead, and publishAcknowledgementTimeout bounds only window sends and the JetStream PublishAsyncTimeout. publishBound's comment (nats.go:877-879) says every publisher with no deadline of its own relies on it, but the Dispatch outbox sends through the window. Keep one constant, or make each comment state its own scope.
The publishConfirmed comment says 'both callers' (confirm.go:26, :36). There are three: publishCoreTo, RequestCoreTo and window.republish.
